data:
Amazon reported diluted earnings per share of **$7.17 for fiscal 2025** (calendar year ended December 31, 2025), up from **$5.53 for fiscal 2024**. That is an increase of about **29.7%**. Net income for fiscal 2025 was about **$77.7 billion**, up from $59.2 billion in fiscal 2024.

Part of the 2025 increase came from non-operating gains, notably on Amazon's investment in Anthropic. That means EPS growth outpaced operating income growth.

These figures come from my own knowledge rather than a live look-up of the filing. Please check them against Amazon's fiscal 2025 Form 10-K or its Q4 2025 earnings release before relying on them.
